maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from franchise royalties and company-operated restaurant sales of burgers and food, which are consumables, not repairs or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers buying fast-food burgers; franchisees pay royalties. No government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by franchising and opening restaurants and menu sales, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other fast-food restaurants. Franchisees are tied by contracts, but the end customer buys on choice.

notes: Franchisees face switching costs, but the answer reflects the consumer-facing burger business.
